privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.summary: Meu Cesto stores only the account and shopping data needed to provide collaborative baskets, lists, price history and private receipts.
privacy.data: We process your account email and preferences, collaboration relationships, shopping lists, baskets, product and price history, and receipt images. We do not store passwords, raw invitation codes, or receipt OCR text in application logs.
privacy.providers: Supabase hosts authentication, database, Realtime and private storage. Open Food Facts supplies optional product suggestions. Anthropic or OpenAI receives a selected receipt only after explicit consent when AI import is configured.
privacy.analytics: Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights receive page-path and performance measurements only. Query strings, form values, receipt content and session replay are excluded.
privacy.retention: Receipts remain while an account is active, become inaccessible on deletion, and are purged 30 days later. Used or expired invitations are purged 90 days after expiry. Audit records are retained for 12 months, then archived when configured or deleted.
privacy.rights: You can correct preferences, export your data, request a password reset and delete your account from Profile.
privacy.security: Receipt images use a private bucket and short-lived signed links after access is checked. Signed links are never stored.
